channel.description: Latest articles from Car and Driver (caranddriver.com)

item.title: View Interior Photos of the 2026 Honda Pilot
item.description: See the interior of the 2026 Honda Pilot from every angle.

item.title: Driven: 2026 Honda Pilot Does Just Enough to Stay Afloat Among 3-Row SUVs
item.description: The upgraded Pilot's extra equipment and freshened look help it remain a solid, if unexciting, choice in this competitive segment.

item.title: View Photos of the 2026 Ford Explorer Tremor
item.description: See the interior and exterior of the 2026 Ford Explorer Tremor from every angle.

item.title: Driven: 2026 Ford Explorer Tremor Asks Big Money for Big Power
item.description: Ford spices things up with a 400-hp twin-turbo V-6, but the package will set you back some $12,000.

item.title: Tesla Will Kill the Model S and Model X to Build Optimus Robots Instead
item.description: Tesla CEO Elon Musk said the electric sedan and SUV that have been flagships for a decade-plus will soon end production.

item.title: Hyundai Planning to Drop Santa Cruz Pickup and Make a Bigger Truck
item.description: The Santa Cruz, which arrived in 2021 and got a facelift in 2025, was expected to get another refresh as soon as next year, though that's now reportedly off the table.

item.title: View Interior Photos of the 2027 Mercedes-Benz S-Class
item.description: Get an up-close look inside the new Mercedes flagship.

item.title: 2027 Mercedes-Benz S-Class's Big Refresh Puts Stars in Its Eyes
item.description: The big Benz sedan gets a star-studded makeover that includes new AI technology and a mightier V-8 engine.

item.title: View Exterior Photos of the 2027 Mercedes-Benz S-Class
item.description: Get a thorough look at the glittering exterior of the new Mercedes flagship.

item.title: 2026 Bentley Continental GT S Aims for the Performance Middle Ground
item.description: The new trim level uses the powertrain from the standard GT and chassis upgrades from the more focused Speed models to create a mid-range option.
